MIND

Works. Connections. Possibilities.

What is a mind? What makes a mind “real”?

A collection for the Gallery Walk. Choose a few ideas, copy their wording onto Post-its, or print a set to cut apart. Add works and expertise as the conversation develops.

Read the full proposal · Get the QR code
Mind & body

Expectation, feeling, healing and skilled action.

Minds beyond humans

Animals, living worlds and artificial systems.

Cultivating mind

Memory, attention, sound and shared practice.

Expressing mind

Poetry, diagrams, language and inner experience.
